title: Baltimore Ravens Defeat Cowboys at the Maracanã with Last-Second Field Goal
seoTitle: Ravens Beat Cowboys at Maracanã with Last-Second Kick
subtitle: Historic NFL game in Brazil ends with Tyler Loop's game-winning kick
excerpt: The first NFL game at the Maracanã ended in a 34-31 Baltimore Ravens win, thanks to Tyler Loop's field goal in the final seconds.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The first NFL game at the Maracanã was decided in the final seconds, when kicker Tyler Loop converted a field goal that secured a 34-31 victory for the Baltimore Ravens over the Dallas Cowboys. The matchup, which drew 72,792 fans, featured three lead changes and a halftime show.

What changed at the Maracanã with the Ravens game

The stadium recorded its largest crowd of 2026, with Brazilian fans cheering on every play. The event was featured prominently across Rede Globo's broadcast networks and included on-field interviews with players such as Lamar Jackson and Derrick Henry.

How Loop's field goal was decisive

With the score tied at 31-31, the Cowboys opted to attempt a field goal with seven seconds remaining. The kick, however, failed, allowing Loop to kick the points that put the Ravens ahead. Loop's celebration, mimicking Cristiano Ronaldo, was a standout moment among fans.

Reaction of the Brazilian players

Lamar Jackson thanked the Brazilian fans, saying they felt “at home” and that the moment was “sensational.” Derrick Henry also praised the crowd, expressing enthusiasm about the team returning to Brazil.

Historical impact of the game

The clash marked the first American football game at the Maracanã and will be remembered as one of the most thrilling moments of the NFL season. The Ravens' victory, sealed with a last-second kick, solidified Tyler Loop's reputation as one of the league's top kickers.

Next steps for the Ravens in Brazil

The players expressed their desire to return to Brazil for more games, showing appreciation for the crowd and the stadium atmosphere. The team has its eyes on future matchups that could take place in the country.

With information from ge, Amazonas1, SelesNafes.com.
